rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a soldier trained to enter combat by parachute.

example.english: I heard he used to be a paratrooper and once parachuted into a combat zone.
example.traditional: 聽講佢以前係傘兵，試過由飛機跳傘落戰區。
